tagline: Global timeshare and vacation ownership company
hero_kpi_rationale: The real estate sales and financing segment is the primary driver of revenues and profitability, reflecting the strategy of acquiring and developing timeshare properties as well as the ability to finance customer purchases.

kpis.name: Real estate sales and financing
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by the sale of vacation ownership products and associated financing.
kpis.description: Estimated value of sales contracts related to inventories available or to be made available in the future.

kpis.name: Fee-for-service and just-in-time inventory
kpis.explanation: Percentage of contract sales from light-capitalization arrangements.
kpis.description: Represents the share of sales realized through agreements where HGV generates commissions and predictable revenue streams without financing acquisition and construction.
kpis.signal: Growth acceleration strategy with lower initial investment.

kpis.name: Financing propensity
kpis.explanation: Percentage of contract sales financed by HGV.
kpis.description: Indicates the proportion of customers who choose to finance their vacation property purchase through HGV.

kpis.name: Historical default rates
kpis.explanation: Percentage of vacation property financing receivables in default.
kpis.description: Measures the percentage of customer loans considered in default (121 days or more past due).

kpis.name: Existing owners contract sales
kpis.explanation: Percentage of contract sales realized with existing customers.
kpis.description: Indicates the proportion of vacation property sales made to members already enrolled in HGV clubs.
kpis.signal: Customer retention and potential for additional sales.

kpis.name: Management fee
kpis.explanation: Commission received by HGV for managing timeshare properties.
kpis.description: Average percentage of a property's operating costs that HGV receives as management fees (range 10-15%), ensuring predictable revenues based on cost-plus formula.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 11.54 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 7.35 billion euros in the latest year

kpis.name: Diamond Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Impact of Diamond Resorts acquisition on operations and growth.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Diamond Resorts in 2021 expanded HGV's property portfolio and member base. Rebranding of numerous Diamond properties to Hilton brands is underway, with expectation to continue this process for the majority of remaining properties.
kpis.signal: Integration and rebranding of acquired properties.

kpis.name: Bluegreen Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Impact of Bluegreen acquisition on operations and growth.
kpis.description: The acquisition of Bluegreen, finalized on January 17, 2024, aims to integrate and rename properties to align with Hilton brand standards. During 2025, rebranding of certain Bluegreen properties commenced, with expectation to continue this process for the majority of remaining properties.
kpis.signal: Rebranding of Bluegreen properties to Hilton brands ongoing since 2025.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and data protection risks
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions cybersecurity as a major risk managed at the CTO/CISO level and audit committee. Language intensity is moderate but the subject is central to governance. Context is stable versus prior year, but the evolving nature of threats justifies high severity.

risks.title: Dependence on third parties for cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes engagement of external experts to assess and test cybersecurity risk management systems. While this strengthens security, it introduces dependence on these third parties. Language intensity is neutral but the risk exists.

risks.title: Third-party vendor risks
risks.score_rationale: The document references processes to identify and mitigate risks related to third-party vendors, including security assessments prior to integration. Language intensity is factual but third-party risk management is critical. Severity is moderate as processes are in place.

risks.title: Litigation and legal proceedings risks
risks.score_rationale: The document indicates the company is subject to claims in legal proceedings arising from its normal operations. Language intensity is standard for this risk type. Severity is moderate as this is a common risk in the sector.

ai_positioning.summary: HGV does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The provided data focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, with no reference to AI or related technology.
